notes.title: Update: build 150928
notes.notes:
- German and French support have been added.
- Screen tearing bug in fullscreen mode has been fixed.
- Several minor bugs has been fixed.

We've reached almost 300 reviews so far, and 90% of reviewers liked our game. Thank you very much. Enjoy!
